## Description

Brief description of changes.

## Related Issue

Fixes #(issue number)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added/updated
- [ ] `cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bin agent-tray` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bin agent-tray -- -D warnings` passes
- [ ] `cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check` passes
- [ ] `bun run check` passes (if frontend changes)
- [ ] `bun run test:ui-model` and `bun run build` pass (if frontend changes)
- [ ] Real-source / native GUI verification described, or explicitly not verified
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable)
- [ ] No breaking changes (or documented in description)
- [ ] No credentials, personal machine configuration or private screenshots added

## Screenshots

If applicable, add screenshots for UI changes.
